reason: Radix AlertDialog.Root and AlertDialog.Portal render no element and closed Overlay/Content are not mounted; a server-rendered Stimulus port needs one controller host (Trigger cannot host it: zero, one or several triggers, or controlled open) and somewhere to ship the closed markup. Neither element carries a data-slot, classes or layout (display: contents / template), so the compared DOM is unchanged.
api: AlertDialog renders one <div style="display: contents" data-controller="chadcn--alert-dialog"> host with no data-slot, classes or other data attributes besides controller wiring
closed Portal children (Overlay, Content) are server-rendered inside a <template> in the host and mounted into document.body on open
AlertDialog::Portal container: is a CSS selector string (a DOM node cannot be passed from Ruby)
